text:
Dashboard Rendering overview > Configuration

By default, dashboard rendering is limited to 5 per workspace on the standard tier. Administrators can raise this limit from the admin console.

To enable dashboard rendering, open the workspace settings panel and select the Dashboards tab. Changes apply within one refresh cycle and do not require a restart.
parent_text:
Configuration

By default, dashboard rendering is limited to 5 per workspace on the standard tier. Administrators can raise this limit from the admin console.

To enable dashboard rendering, open the workspace settings panel and select the Dashboards tab. Changes apply within one refresh cycle and do not require a restart.

Audit events for dashboard rendering are written to the workspace audit log within 60 seconds and retained for 13 months on the enterprise tier.

When dashboard rendering is combined with row-level security, evaluation happens before aggregation. Plan calculated fields accordingly.

If your organization uses SAML SSO, dashboard rendering inherits group membership from your identity provider on each login.

text:
Dashboard Rendering overview > Common errors

### ERR-1102: Dashboard render timeout

Cause: Widget query exceeded the 60 second render budget.

Resolution: Reduce widget count or enable result caching on the underlying dataset.

This issue is fixed in version 5.0. Affected versions: 4.8, 4.9.

### ERR-1147: Cross-filter loop detected

Cause: Two widgets reference each other as filter sources.

Resolution: Remove one direction of the cross-filter relationship.

text:

Audit events for Slack delivery are written to the workspace audit log within 60 seconds and retained for 13 months on the enterprise tier.

parent_text:
Configuration

Audit events for Slack delivery are written to the workspace audit log within 60 seconds and retained for 13 months on the enterprise tier.

To enable Slack delivery, open the workspace settings panel and select the Alerts & Scheduled Reports tab. Changes apply within one refresh cycle and do not require a restart.

By default, Slack delivery is limited to 50 per workspace on the enterprise tier. Administrators can raise this limit from the admin console.

Cause: RLS rules referencing calculated fields are evaluated after aggregation.

Resolution: Rewrite the RLS rule against a raw column, not a calculated field.

To enable refresh failure retries, open the workspace settings panel and select the Datasets tab. Changes apply within one refresh cycle and do not require a restart.

If your organization uses SAML SSO, refresh failure retries inherits group membership from your identity provider on each login.
parent_text:
Configuration

If your organization uses SAML SSO, refresh failure retries inherits group membership from your identity provider on each login.

Performance tip: refresh failure retries performs best when the underlying dataset uses incremental refresh. Full refreshes invalidate the associated cache.

By default, refresh failure retries is limited to 50 per workspace on the professional tier. Administrators can raise this limit from the admin console.

text:
How to configure API authentication > Configuration

When API authentication is combined with row-level security, evaluation happens before aggregation. Plan calculated fields accordingly.

To enable API authentication, open the workspace settings panel and select the REST API & Embedding tab. Changes apply within one refresh cycle and do not require a restart.
parent_text:
Configuration

When API authentication is combined with row-level security, evaluation happens before aggregation. Plan calculated fields accordingly.

To enable API authentication, open the workspace settings panel and select the REST API & Embedding tab. Changes apply within one refresh cycle and do not require a restart.

Audit events for API authentication are written to the workspace audit log within 60 seconds and retained for 13 months on the enterprise tier.

Performance tip: API authentication performs best when the underlying dataset uses incremental refresh. Full refreshes invalidate the associated cache.

By default, API authentication is limited to 10 per workspace on the enterprise tier. Administrators can raise this limit from the admin console.

Cause: RLS rules referencing calculated fields are evaluated after aggregation.

Resolution: Rewrite the RLS rule against a raw column, not a calculated field.

parent_text:
Configuration

To enable row-level security, open the workspace settings panel and select the Datasets tab. Changes apply within one refresh cycle and do not require a restart.

When row-level security is combined with row-level security, evaluation happens before aggregation. Plan calculated fields accordingly.

By default, row-level security is limited to 25 per workspace on the standard tier. Administrators can raise this limit from the admin console.

Performance tip: row-level security performs best when the underlying dataset uses incremental refresh. Full refreshes invalidate the associated cache.

If your organization uses SAML SSO, row-level security inherits group membership from your identity provider on each login.

title: Salesforce integration guide

text:
Salesforce integration guide > Setup steps

1. In the workspace, open Data Connectors and choose Salesforce from the catalog.
2. Enter the connection settings above and provide your OAuth 2.0 credential.
3. Run the connection test. A successful test validates network reachability, authentication, and schema access in one pass.
4. Choose the schemas to expose. Scoping schemas speeds up discovery on large catalogs.
5. Save. The connector appears in the dataset builder within one minute.

### ERR-2231: OAuth token refresh rejected

Cause: TLS negotiation failed because the warehouse requires TLS 1.3.

Resolution: Enable TLS 1.3 in the connector advanced settings, available in 5.0 and later.

Fixed in version 5.0. Affected versions: 4.8, 4.9.

title: SAP HANA integration guide
section_path: Integrations > SAP HANA
text:
SAP HANA integration guide > Common errors

### ERR-2231: OAuth token refresh rejected

Cause: Refresh token expired after the identity provider rotated signing keys.

Resolution: Reauthorize the connection from the connector settings page.

### ERR-2209: Connector handshake failed

Cause: TLS negotiation failed because the warehouse requires TLS 1.3.

Resolution: Enable TLS 1.3 in the connector advanced settings, available in 5.0 and later.

Fixed in version 5.0. Affected versions: 4.8, 4.9.

title: Dropbox integration guide
section_path: Integrations > Dropbox
text:
Dropbox integration guide > Common errors

### ERR-2209: Connector handshake failed

Cause: TLS negotiation failed because the warehouse requires TLS 1.3.

Resolution: Enable TLS 1.3 in the connector advanced settings, available in 5.0 and later.

Fixed in version 5.0. Affected versions: 4.8, 4.9.

### ERR-2288: Schema discovery timed out

Cause: Warehouse information_schema query exceeded 120 seconds on very large catalogs.

title: Airbyte integration guide
section_path: Integrations > Airbyte
text:
Airbyte integration guide > Setup steps

1. In the workspace, open Data Connectors and choose Airbyte from the catalog.
2. Enter the connection settings above and provide your API key credential.
3. Run the connection test. A successful test validates network reachability, authentication, and schema access in one pass.
4. Choose the schemas to expose. Scoping schemas speeds up discovery on large catalogs.
5. Save. The connector appears in the dataset builder within one minute.

title: Airbyte integration guide
section_path: Integrations > Airbyte
text:
Airbyte integration guide > Common errors

### ERR-2231: OAuth token refresh rejected

Cause: Refresh token expired after the identity provider rotated signing keys.

Resolution: Reauthorize the connection from the connector settings page.

### ERR-2209: Connector handshake failed

Cause: TLS negotiation failed because the warehouse requires TLS 1.3.

Resolution: Enable TLS 1.3 in the connector advanced settings, available in 5.0 and later.

Fixed in version 5.0. Affected versions: 4.8, 4.9.

title: Airbyte integration guide
section_path: Integrations > Airbyte
text:
Airbyte integration guide > Credential rotation

Rotate Airbyte credentials from the connector settings page. Rotation is zero downtime: the platform validates the new credential before retiring the old one. Expired credentials surface as ERR-2231 in the connector health panel.

title: ERR-1102: Dashboard render timeout
section_path: Known Issues > Dashboards
text:
ERR-1102: Dashboard render timeout

Symptom: Users encounter ERR-1102 (dashboard render timeout).
Root cause: Widget query exceeded the 60 second render budget
Workaround: Reduce widget count or enable result caching on the underlying dataset
Affected versions: 4.8, 4.9
Fixed in: 5.0

title: ERR-1147: Cross-filter loop detected
section_path: Known Issues > Dashboards
text:
ERR-1147: Cross-filter loop detected

Symptom: Users encounter ERR-1147 (cross-filter loop detected).
Root cause: Two widgets reference each other as filter sources
Workaround: Remove one direction of the cross-filter relationship
Affected versions: 4.8, 4.9, 5.0, 5.1
Fixed in: not yet fixed

title: ERR-1210: PDF export failed: asset too large
section_path: Known Issues > Dashboards
text:
ERR-1210: PDF export failed: asset too large

Symptom: Users encounter ERR-1210 (pdf export failed: asset too large).
Root cause: Rendered dashboard exceeds the 50 MB export ceiling
Workaround: Export tabs individually or lower image DPI in export settings
Affected versions: 4.9, 5.0
Fixed in: 5.1

title: ERR-2209: Connector handshake failed
section_path: Known Issues > Data Connectors
text:
ERR-2209: Connector handshake failed

Symptom: Users encounter ERR-2209 (connector handshake failed).
Root cause: TLS negotiation failed because the warehouse requires TLS 1.3
Workaround: Enable TLS 1.3 in the connector advanced settings, available in 5.0 and later
Affected versions: 4.8, 4.9
Fixed in: 5.0

title: ERR-2231: OAuth token refresh rejected
section_path: Known Issues > Data Connectors
text:
ERR-2231: OAuth token refresh rejected

Symptom: Users encounter ERR-2231 (oauth token refresh rejected).
Root cause: Refresh token expired after the identity provider rotated signing keys
Workaround: Reauthorize the connection from the connector settings page
Affected versions: 4.8, 4.9, 5.0, 5.1
Fixed in: not yet fixed

title: ERR-2288: Schema discovery timed out
section_path: Known Issues > Data Connectors
text:
ERR-2288: Schema discovery timed out

Symptom: Users encounter ERR-2288 (schema discovery timed out).
Root cause: Warehouse information_schema query exceeded 120 seconds on very large catalogs
Workaround: Scope the connection to specific schemas instead of the full catalog
Affected versions: 4.8, 4.9, 5.0
Fixed in: 5.1

title: ERR-3305: Dataset refresh deadlock
section_path: Known Issues > Datasets
text:
ERR-3305: Dataset refresh deadlock

Symptom: Users encounter ERR-3305 (dataset refresh deadlock).
Root cause: Concurrent incremental refresh and full refresh acquired locks in opposite order
Workaround: Stagger refresh schedules or disable overlapping refresh in dataset settings
Affected versions: 4.8, 4.9, 5.0
Fixed in: 5.1

text:
ERR-6640: Signed embed URL expired

Symptom: Users encounter ERR-6640 (signed embed url expired).
Root cause: Embed URLs are valid for 10 minutes; the host page cached one longer
Workaround: Generate embed URLs server side per page load, never cache them
Affected versions: 4.9, 5.0, 5.1

title: ERR-7719: SAML assertion rejected

text:
ERR-7719: SAML assertion rejected

Root cause: Clock skew between the identity provider and the platform exceeded 5 minutes
Workaround: Sync IdP server clocks with NTP; skew tolerance is configurable in 5.1
Affected versions: 4.8, 4.9, 5.0
Fixed in: 5.1

title: ERR-7733: SCIM provisioning conflict

text:

Root cause: A SCIM push tried to create a user whose email already exists as a local account
Workaround: Convert the local account to SSO before enabling SCIM for that domain
Affected versions: 4.9, 5.0, 5.1
